tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: List the 60 countries covered by NERAI's daily risk indices (code + name), plus platform metadata (as-of dates, calibration).

tools.name: get_country_risk
tools.description: Full NERAI risk read for one country: HMM regime state (Calm/Tension/Crisis with escalation probability and persistence), resilience score, and risk topics as percentiles of the 30-day average vs each series' own history (now / 90d ago / delta), with calibrated shock probabilities at 4/9/13/26-week

tools.name: get_causal_drivers
tools.description: NERAI's causal network for a country: Granger-significant lead-lag relationships (p<0.01) showing which risk signals lead which others, with the lag in days and F-statistic. Use to explain WHY a risk is building, not just that it is.

tools.name: get_early_warning
tools.description: Platform-wide early warning: the series with the highest calibrated shock probabilities right now, and the biggest 90-day percentile movers (risers and fallers) across all 60 countries. The fastest way to ask 'what should I be watching?'

tools.name: compare_countries
tools.description: Rank countries on a given risk topic by current percentile, with the 90-day change and regime state. Use for portfolio or footprint screening (e.g. 'rank protest risk across our markets').

tools.name: get_supply_chain_risk
tools.description: Global supply-chain picture: NY Fed GSCPI (with its required notice), country disruption readings and NERAI's supply-disruption forecast board. Chokepoint transit series are not included in this edition (chokepoint_transits is null).

tools.name: get_commodities
tools.description: Benchmark commodity prices from licensed open sources: U.S. EIA daily spot (Brent, WTI, Henry Hub; public domain) with 7- and 30-day changes, and World Bank Pink Sheet monthly averages (European gas, wheat, maize, urea; CC BY 4.0) with the month-on-month change. tools.name: get_sanctions_overview
tools.description: The sanctions picture in one call: restricted-party register counts by list and type, the Russia shadow-fleet enforcement index, Russia economic-impact measures and recent enforcement actions.

tools.name: get_live_chokepoint_traffic
tools.description: Chokepoint vessel picture from licensed sources. Live AIS vessel counts are NOT available in this edition (available=false, counts null). tools.description: Risk state of the 8 monitored maritime corridors (Hormuz, Suez, Red Sea/Bab-el-Mandeb, Black Sea, Malacca, Taiwan Strait, E. Mediterranean, South China Sea): GDELT-based threat/activity scores, phase, news and sanctions intensity, NERAI read. Transit and cost-pressure fields are kept for compatibili

tools.name: get_circumvention_corridors
tools.description: NERAI CHPL circumvention-corridor intensity scores (0-100, ordinal) for Russia-bound diversion routes of controlled microelectronics, with goods and watch items.

tools.name: get_forecast_desk
tools.description: NERAI's open calibrated forecasts (binary questions with probabilities and horizons) across sanctions, geopolitical risk, chokepoints, maritime, supply-chain and conflict. Every open question is re-scored every 2 days, so each one carries its probability history, the change since it was filed and si

tools.name: check_commodity_controls
tools.description: Look up an HS code against the Common High Priority List — the goods the US, EU, UK and Japan jointly identify as most frequently diverted. Requires a six-digit code: a four-digit heading returns the CHPL subheadings it contains and asks for HS6, because the goods within one heading differ materiall

tools.name: find_enforcement_precedent
tools.description: Published enforcement actions (ECJU compound settlements, OFSI penalties, BIS denial orders, OFAC civil penalties) that share features with a described shipment. A case qualifies only if it shares the commodity or the behaviour AND the destination or route — shared geography alone is not a precedent

tools.name: get_transaction_intelligence_status
tools.description: What NERAI's transaction layer currently covers: register size and per-source health, enforcement corpus size by authority, CHPL vintage, and which checks require the platform rather than this connector. Use it to know what a full assessment would add.

tools.name: get_tradecontrol_changes
tools.description: Latest official trade-control / sanctions changes from the NERAI TradeControl Action Desk: UK Sanctions List & US CSL diffs and CELEX-anchored EU Official Journal acts, each with legal instrument and source link.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_forecast_desk · Public sink: find_enforcement_precedent.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_forecast_desk · Public sink: find_enforcement_precedent

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
